task.ques: Find out which four teams the NFC North contains in the NFL on ESPN.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The NFL's NFC North contains the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
Evidence: ESPN's NFL Teams page lists all four under "NFC North": https://www.espn.com/nfl/teams (viewed October 28, 2026). Screenshot: final.png.
